query:
-- Scenic Design Process articles
UPDATE articles 
SET categoryId = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = 'scenic-design-process' LIMIT 1)
WHERE slug IN (
  'navigating-the-scenic-design-process-a-comprehensive-guide',
  'you-re-wasting-my-time-a-scenic-design-lesson-in-growth-and-revision',
  'becoming-a-scenic-designer',
  'what-makes-a-good-scenic-design-rendering',
  'computer-hardware-why-scenic-designers-and-all-theatre-designers-need-to-care'
);

-- Technology & Tutorials articles
UPDATE articles 
SET categoryId = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = 'technology-tutorials' LIMIT 1)
WHERE slug IN (
  'empowering-theatre-production-students-with-computer-literacy',
  'lighting-styles-in-ai-models',
  'online-portfolio-theatrical-design-2026'
);

-- Design Philosophy articles  
UPDATE articles 
SET categoryId = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = 'design-philosophy' LIMIT 1)
WHERE slug IN (
  'the-modern-theatrical-design-portfolio'
);
